name: Gestures_Angry_3
short_caption: The robot throws its hands up in a brief, dramatic gesture of frustration before bringing them low in a tense pose.
movement_description: The robot starts in a neutral posture and quickly raises both arms out to the sides with open hands, tilting its head slightly backward in a sudden, dramatic outburst. It then lowers its arms back down to its sides momentarily before bringing both hands forward in front of its hips, palms facing inward and fingers slightly curled in a tense, defensive-looking posture. The robot remains in this low-hands posture as the clip ends.
safety_notes: The sudden outward arm movement requires a small clear zone around the sides of the robot.
